title: Carve 0.2 inline scan
description: The four steps of the one left-to-right scan of a content, in their fixed order of precedence.

rank.description: The place in the order, from 1.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

file.description: The data file of this directory that lists the forms of the step.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.
